src.label: Latvian Food and Veterinary Service (PVD) — non-commercial movement of pets to Latvia

head: Since 22 April 2026 Delegated Regulation 2026/131 sets the rules; very young or unvaccinated pets are refused.
lines: The PVD says that from 22 April 2026 the rules for dogs, cats and ferrets travelling for non-commercial reasons come from Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131.
Latvia will not admit a dog, cat or ferret under 12 weeks old, one that is not vaccinated against rabies, or one aged 12 to 16 weeks whose vaccination has not yet become valid.

For travel from outside the EU the PVD sends owners to the European Commission page on bringing a pet into the EU from a non-EU country. The Latvian page itself lists no certificate or titre-test details.
